description: This file defines a class 'DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' that wraps and delegates logging functions to an underlying 'DiagnosticLoggingAdapter', providing thread-safe MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management and logging capabilities within an Akka-based environment.

classes.name: DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around an Akka DiagnosticLoggingAdapter that manages MDC entries and delegates logging calls.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of DefaultDiagnosticLoggingAdapter with specified logging adapter and logger name.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message with an associated Throwable cause.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as an immutable Scala Map.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Sets the MDC using an immutable Scala Map.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current MDC as a mutable Java Map.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets the MDC with the provided Map.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates a MDC entry with a key and value.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a MDC entry by key.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Clears local and actual MDC entries.
